recipe.visualDefinition: A dynamic 1960s-inspired layout featuring a diagonally striped background in muted green and lavender, overlaid with a high-contrast, angled portrait of a male vocalist and a mix of bold sans-serif and fluid script typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The 45-degree diagonal background stripes create a sense of rhythmic movement.
The subject's head and microphone are tilted to align with the upward typographic slant.
Contrast between the heavy black block lettering and the light, airy white script.
The subject's torso fades into the background stripes through a sharp diagonal crop.
coreInvariants: Diagonal stripe pattern at a consistent 45-degree angle.
Triadic color scheme of sage green, dusty lavender, and salmon-pink accents.
High-contrast, warm-toned photography with visible film grain.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned in the lower-left quadrant, angled upward toward the center, occupying approximately 40% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, white script 'G' in the center-right serves as the primary focal point for the title.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal stripes from bottom-left to top-right, guided by the tilt of the subject's head and the primary text line.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the upper-left and lower-right corners, occupied by secondary metadata and logos.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sage green serves as the primary background field.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dusty lavender stripes provide rhythmic contrast against the green.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Salmon-pink thin pinstripes and stark white script provide highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, desaturated mid-tones in the background allow the high-value white text and high-contrast black text to pop.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif and upright brush script
letterConstructionRules: Display text is heavy, wide, and slanted at a 15-degree upward angle.
Script text is fluid with high stroke contrast and a large, flourishing initial capital.
Body text is a clean, light-weight grotesque sans-serif.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Exaggerated descender on the script 'G' to anchor the center-right composition.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy geometric sans-serif for authority paired with a casual script for rhythm and 'soul'.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the mid-century industrial sans-serif look of the main name.
Provides the mid-century rhythmic script feel for the title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a background of 45-degree diagonal stripes alternating between sage green and dusty lavender, separated by thin salmon-pink pinstripes. Place a high-contrast, warm-toned portrait of a man singing into a microphone in the lower-left, tilted 15 degrees upward, with his torso sharply cropped diagonally.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary name in a heavy, black, extended geometric sans-serif at the top, tilted 15 degrees. Add the secondary title in a white, fluid brush script in the center-right, also tilted 15 degrees. Place a small bulleted list of text in a light sans-serif in the bottom-left corner.

verificationChecks: Are the stripes at a consistent 45-degree angle?
Is the text tilted at exactly 15 degrees upward?
Is the color palette muted and retro?
Does the subject's crop follow the diagonal flow?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is perfectly horizontal.
Check that the script 'G' or initial is the largest element in the subtitle.
Verify the presence of the thin pink pinstripe between the main green and lavender bands.
Confirm the photo has a warm, slightly yellowed vintage cast.
recipe.reuseFormula: Diagonal Stripe Background + Tilted Extended Sans-Serif + Overlapping Script + High-Contrast Angled Portrait
